# Thomas Kabalin

> Third-year Bachelor of Business Science (Computer Science) student at UCT, currently ranked first across the Computer Science cohort, and Junior Software Engineer at a Cape Town fintech. Interested in software engineering, AI engineering, data science, and the practical application of technology to business problems.

Thomas Kabalin is a South African student and software engineer based in Cape Town, South Africa. As of 2026, he is in his third year of a Bachelor of Business Science (Computer Science) degree at the University of Cape Town (UCT), a four-year programme, with an expected graduation year of 2027. He is currently ranked first across the Computer Science cohort, with a first-year GPA of 88.13 and a second-year GPA of 85.68. He combines strong technical and analytical ability with a commercial mindset, and is drawn to using AI as a practical tool to build faster and automate manual processes.

His professional interests span software engineering, AI engineering, data science, the practical applications of AI, quantitative development, and technology-driven problem solving. He is actively exploring a range of career paths at the intersection of technology and business.

## Work Experience

**Junior Software Engineer**
Fynbos Technologies (Fynbos Money) · January 2026–Present
Build and ship backend features part-time for a PHP (Laravel) fintech investment platform. Built from scratch a bank reconciliation system that auto-matches ~81% of transactions (replacing manual spreadsheet matching previously done by senior staff), and a direct-to-bank withdrawal feature that removes a manual step for customers. Applies emerging techniques in prompt, context, and memory engineering to orchestrate and critically review AI-generated code throughout. Fynbos is a Cape Town-based fintech focused on making financial products — including tax-free savings accounts and investment accounts — more accessible to South Africans.

---

**Entrepreneur**
Digital Study Materials Business · January 2021–Present
Markets and sells digital study notes to high school and university students, with a peak annual profit of R16,000 (2024). Designed and built an automated sales and fulfilment pipeline (Google Forms, Sheets, Apps Script) with automated buyer notifications and branded fulfilment emails, removing manual handling from each sale.

---

**Data Entry Assistant** (Seasonal)
Cannons Creek Independent School · January 2025 & 2026
Supported the executive head with student data administration (EdAdmin, CEMIS) and calendar management.

## Leadership & Extra-Curricular

**External Moderator (Volunteer), SA Applications Olympiad & Talent Search (2026–Present)**
Serves as one of two national external moderators for competitions reaching over 50,000 participants annually — the Applications Olympiad, a computer literacy contest for high school learners, and the Talent Search, a computational thinking challenge — reviewing papers, identifying errors, and recommending improvements.

**Scientific Committee Member (Volunteer), SA Programming Olympiad (2024–Present)**
Designs and reviews algorithmic problems for South Africa's national programming contest, whose winners represent the country at the International Olympiad in Informatics, developing and inspiring the next generation of computer scientists.

**Head of Sound, Lighting & AV Team, Cannons Creek Independent High School (2021–2022)**
Oversaw ~150 school events, as well as the training and management of the student technical team. During COVID-19, deployed a live-streaming system for valedictory and prize-giving, enabling parents worldwide to attend remotely at no additional cost to the school, and developed an automated booking system to streamline event scheduling and coordination.
